notes.title: Optimum Link Photo Contest
notes.content:
Long time, huh! Ok let's get straight to it. There's no reason an older game can't have another moment to shine. So we had a fun idea.

[h1]WE'RE HAVING A CONTEST[/h1]
Starting August 13th and ending August 27th, take some screenshots in game and share them either in the Steam community, on the Optimum Link [url=https://discord.gg/czAaEBE]Discord[/url], or both. It can be funny, interesting, broken, meme-worthy, or terrifying -- share your best! The dev team will look at the aftermath after August 27th, where we'll decide on 1st place, 2nd place, and 3rd place winners. The winners will receive Steam gift cards of [b]$25, $10, and $5,[/b] respectively. Anybody can vote for their favorite using Likes/Thumbs Up, but in addition to popularity there are a few other qualities we'll judge. Even if you don't care for prizes, it's a great time to jump back in and revisit a wacky sandbox game! Game's not that old!

Rules are subject to change because we've never done a contest before and we might encounter something unexpected and try to make something more fair. But basically:

[h1]RULES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Up to [b]3[/b] submissions per player. If you submit via both Discord and Steam, no worries, we will just count them as one. Votes will be combined.
[*] Screenshots must be taken [i]on[/i] or [i]between[/i] August 13th 2021 and August 27th 2021.
[*] Screenshots must not be edited. You can use whatever you want to take the picture, just don't modify what appears to be game content. If you are doing a live stream, be sure your submission is taken from your screen, not from the stream output.
[*] Screenshots must be your gameplay. Do not submit screenshots of other players' gameplay.
[*] Winners will have 3 business days to collect their prize after announced. Failure to cooperate or reply to contact will result in that prize being given to someone else.
[*] Submissions may be disqualified if the community or developers thinks it contains [b]offensive[/b] content.
[*] Participants agree submissions (only the image) may be used by Protoria Studios in game content, social media, or marketing material.
[/list]

[h1]HOW TO TAKE A SCREENSHOT IN-GAME[/h1]
Optimum Link has a photo mode. You can use this to frame the camera, or just do regular gameplay. Doesn't matter. The simplest way to then capture this is just [b]hitting F12 on your keyboard[/b], which should capture the game's screen via Steam. [b]Steam then has these images ready to upload[/b] when you are done playing the game. This is the easiest way, but if you're savvy with screenshot tools and want to do things another way, go for it! Just remember the no modifying rule.

[b]You can submit up to 3.[/b]

[h1]HOW ARE THE WINNERS DECIDED?[/h1]
Throughout the contest, anyone can "vote" for favorite submissions via Thumbs Up. You can vote for as many as you want, even ALL of them. At the end, each submission will be scored from [b]2-10 points[/b] in each of the following qualities:

[b]- Popularity (thumbs up received)
- Character customization
- Dream-like imagery
- Aesthetics
- Humor[/b]

So don't worry; popularity from likes is not critical. However, it can help, so we encourage all participants to give fellow submissions a look and share the support.

[h1]HOW DO I COLLECT MY PRIZE?[/h1]
We'll have to contact you. So please follow us on [url=https://discord.gg/czAaEBE]Discord[/url] or at least pay attention on Steam for when we announce the winners!

[h1]CONTENT CREATORS[/h1]
We encourage you to stream or share videos! The game is pretty wonky, we get it.. So go crazy with it! Encourage your audience to participate and win up to $25 on Steam. The more screenshots we receive, the more interesting this gets!

[h1]AND HEY.[/h1]
This is the first time we've ever done an event like this. It may go terribly wrong. But we'll learn from it and improve for next time. This event also doubles as a chance for us to get more feedback on the game itself, so we can improve future versions of the game (wink).

Have fun of course!

notes.title: A Silver Winter
notes.content:
Welcome to Silver Sparrow, Optimum Link’s official completion. This update seeks to clarify and enforce the game’s best elements.

What’s New?
[list]
[*] Added 3 new worlds.
[*] Added Mazes.
[*] Swimming works now.
[*] Everything is available in the Create menu now.
[*] You can hold things now, press [E].
[*] You can drop Ammo now, by pressing [J], or spawn it from the Create menu.
[*] You can toggle the HUD on/off by pressing [\].
[*] You can slow down time by holding [CTRL] + using the scroll wheel.
[*] You can adjust the size of your primer spray by holding [ALT] + scroll wheel.
[*] Added profanity filter on chat.
[*] Adjusting post processing. Game image is now sharper and has less bloom/lens flare.
[*] Refactored and rebuilt: switching tools, painting, lasers, selecting items, spawning items, telekinesis, damage events, death & respawn, player join, basically everything.
[*] New sounds for lots of things.
[*] Improved enemy AI.
[*] Hitboxes adjusted so players don't clip through walls.
[*] Interaction range is larger and starts slightly closer to player's feet.
[*] Telekinetic wave made slightly smaller, but begins much closer to the player's viewpoint, which makes hitting closer targets much easier.
[*] World lighting on all maps adjusted to handle shadows at a much faster rate. Render time should be significantly reduced.
[*] Unhooked "Set Design" function (spawns handful of procedurals at the dawn of a server), which eliminates a horrid hitch at the start of entering worlds. There isn't really even a big trade off, procedurals will spawn like normal, but now just starting from nothing.
[*] Game Machines NPC count reduced. Makes it much less ridiculous.
[*] More "set" objects and particles, artworks, and audio.
[*] Now only tools and batteries will prompt a pickup, any misc objects are left to physics.
[/list]

About Multiplayer

We've found that 1.) a majority of players preferred playing single player, and 2). many players did not find good experiences with random players, and often times connecting to players outside of your region caused issues. In effort to give you the best experience, the game has been simplified to an invite system. Just hit 'Play' and you're good, you're in a game. If you want to play with others, open the Friend/Server menu and invite them. On a technical level, this game's multiplayer was very experimental, and we've used it as a learning experience for our next projects.

Designer Notes

This update comes with bittersweet news. Optimum Link was started in 2015, as a mere experiment. At the end of four years, and with lots of other projects being cooked, the Protoria team has decided it’s best to wrap this game up. We originally wanted this game to have a dynamic lifetime and live alongside future projects, but we care tremendously about the quality of our games - we’d rather focus on one game at a time. Rather than just leaving it, however, we did put a lot of effort into fixing existing problems and giving you some more content. We’re pretty happy to give this game a “finished” sticker, and a good rest as well.

We hope you all enjoy <3

We have a discord, if you’d like to: [url=https://discord.gg/czAaEBE]teleport![/url]
Our next game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814330/Skyfear/]Skyfear[/url]

notes.title: Welcome to the Dream.
notes.content:
Responses to this project have been interesting, to say the least. The team has been enjoying all the screenshots and reviews. I wanted to make a post to let interested players know what's up, that we hear you, and how we're moving forward.

First, bugs. Yup! Most of them are noted. I cannot guarantee all will be fixed, we will do our best.

Second, new content. We have a TON of ideas. I'm just going to try and emphasize that we don't want to anticipate anything in advance, since this is an experimental side project. Indie development can get very busy very quickly.

This is exciting for us, and hopefully you all, too. Give the game another go if you haven't opened it in a while... you never know what could happen.

TL;DR - We love your feedback, and we'll try to surprise you with more when we can.

- telekrex (creator)
